name: Church Planting Taskforce
summary: The Church Planting Taskforce (CPT) encourages CRCA churches in the task of planting churches throughout Australia.

body.heading: About the taskforce
paragraphs: The Church Planting Taskforce (CPT) encourages CRCA churches in the task of planting churches throughout Australia. It researches how churches can be planted and renewed, and it helps fund local churches that are trying something new.

body.heading: What the CPT researches
list: How effective it is to multiply congregations
Models of church reinvigoration and church planting
Base numbers and goal numbers for church planting (where we start and what we are aiming for)
The areas, geographical and sociological, where we are not reaching the community
Where we can have the most effective outreach

body.heading: Seed funding for Missional Explorations
paragraphs: Missional Explorations are a stepping stone between a congregation's regular outreach and a new church plant. Under the supervision of the local church, an exploration might develop its own identity and lead to a formal church plant.
The CPT matches local church funding up to $2,500. The money can go towards core-team training, equipment, venue hire and printing promotional material.

facts.label: Who it's for
facts.value: CRCA churches thinking about planting or renewal

facts.label: Seed funding
facts.value: Matched up to $2,500 with the local church
